author: Italkebby
title: Ottima app per ascoltare musica

Ottimo lavoro in costante aggiornamento e rispondono alle segnalazioni.

author: r8184n73
title: A potentially amazing player
content:
Few times I've found around a nice and complete player as Evermusic is:  UX, feature set and number of supported platforms are just a few of it key points. At the same time I've to strongly complain about
- the so slooooow media library build-up;
- the fact that although "do in the background" is enabled everywhere the media library keeps updating only when the screen is up and running.

These two points require investigation from development in order to offer a solid cloud-based player

Last but not least, it would be nice to see:
- gapless playback 
- volume leveling 

Keep up with the good work.
